title: Submit Success Morph
description: Bấm nút gửi, nút nhún nhẹ rồi giãn rộng thành viền có vòng xoay ĐANG GỬI, sau đó co lại thành nút xanh có dấu tích ĐÃ GỬI.

credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Pill button 44 px tall. Press 0.45-0.6 s: scale 1 → 0.96 → 1. Width on a spring k260 c24 (sum of springs): 128 → 176 at 0.55 s (sending) → 140 at 1.9 s (sent) → 128 at 2.95 s. 0.55-0.75 s crossfade to an outlined surface with a spinning 8 px arc (about 240°, 8 rad/s) and 'SENDING…'; 1.9-2.05 s crossfade to green with a tick drawing over 2.0-2.3 s and 'SENT'. Each new label rises 4 px as it fades in. Reset to SEND 2.95-3.15 s. Params: widths ([128, 176, 140] px) · spring (k260 c24) · times ([0.55, 1.9] s) · labels. The width is a sum of springs between the states; each new label rises 4 px as it fades in; the spinner is a 240° arc at 8 rad/s.
